# JDK modules jlink puts into the bundled runtime (--add-modules), shared by all
# three packaging scripts. One module per line; # starts a comment.
#
# The first block is what `jdeps --print-module-deps` reports over the staged
# target/app tree; the second is the runtime-only set jdeps can't see (service
# providers and reflective lookups), so don't drop those just because nothing
# references them at compile time.

java.base
java.compiler          # Rhino's optional compiler hooks (qml4j JS expressions)
java.desktop           # AWT/Swing tray, ImageIO (cover colour extraction), clipboard
java.logging
java.management        # ManagementFactory, used to get our own pid on exit
java.naming
java.rmi
java.scripting
java.sql

jdk.charsets           # GBK/Cp1252 fallbacks for netease payloads and local filenames
jdk.crypto.ec          # EC cipher suites — without it every netease HTTPS call fails
jdk.dynalink
jdk.localedata         # non-US locales (zh date/number formatting)
jdk.unsupported        # sun.misc.Unsafe: LWJGL, Skija, gson
jdk.zipfs
